narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -11.50 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.1745-0.1794 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.1806; the first objective pays 0.65R at 0.1732.

plan.triggerRule: footprint exh fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.1806 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 0.65 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 25/100 — trend broken, liq magnets below, whales offering
